title: Component Types Schema
description: Schema for component type definitions that define how to process files for building. Linting is configured separately in lint-providers.yml.

component-types.description: Map of component type name to configuration

component_type.description: A component type definition that describes how to process files of a specific type

extensions.description: File extensions that belong to this component type (e.g., [".go"], [".md"], [".go.txt"]). Empty for non-file-based components.

builder.description: The build handler to use for this component type (e.g., "go", "mkdocs", "buildx")

scanners.description: Default scanners for this component type. Omit or empty = not scannable.

build_weight.description: Resource weight for parallel build scheduling. Higher = more resource pressure. Default is 1.

build_after.description: Component types that must complete before this one within the same module

requirements.description: System dependencies required for building this component type (e.g., ["go"], ["docker"])

default_root.description: Default root path pattern for this component type. Supports {moniker} variable for module-specific paths (e.g., 'specs/{moniker}' for specs component).

files.description: Default file patterns for this component type
